build.note: Measurement binary compiled with rustc -O from this source and existing debug dependency rlibs; all three modes in the same binary. Production SHM source included unchanged; Rust Pipe/WS are minimal blocking clients, not product managers.

environmentAfter.cpu: model name	: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11700 @ 2.50GHz

environmentBefore.cpu: model name	: 11th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-11700 @ 2.50GHz

method: One Python process and identical EchoHandler. Sequential request/echo (one outstanding), identical payloads and warmup/count. RTT includes sender framing, mask/copy, peer JSON parse/dump and complete reply receive. Exact payload validation outside each RTT timer. Throughput counts both payload directions (2 * payloadBytes), computed from sum of RTT samples; excludes warmup and validation.

pythonPeer.handler: one shared EchoHandler, identical JSON parse/dump and binary echo
pythonPeer.websocket: plain RFC6455 binary messages, compression=None, no SecureWS encryption

scope: Linux Rust/Python carrier-only round-trip benchmark; excludes WebView, game and product SecureWS encryption
quietSamplingWindow: Root paused UI operations and builds during this run; application remained idle in SHM mode. Other desktop/background processes were not stopped.
